title: vtc-00: group ring calls admit only first answer
description: Answer requires state ringing (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:785); first answer makes the call active (:1543), so later targets fail and have no join path. Initiator record has joinedAt null (:580,:1790) and nothing sets it; an initiator joinMethod update counts as answering. Fix: initiator joined at create; remaining targets keep ringing and may answer while active until decline or timeout.
close_reason: Initiator joined at creation; answers accepted while ringing or active if callResponse pending; other targets keep ringing until timeout; 'answered' end reason removed.
